acceptanceCriteria: The gate or a preflight names a stale or mismatched portable consumer distinctly from a real verifier disagreement.
corvint-update (or the documented install route) rebuilds and installs cem01-go together with corvint.
body: Observed 2026-10-18 on V1-1677: the policy's cem-verdict gate runs /Users/russelllewis/.local/bin/corvint (rc.3 build 634, installed 2026-10-17) with --portable-consumer /Users/russelllewis/.local/bin/cem01-go (built 2026-10-13, before interop/cem01-go change 337f6e72f on 2026-10-16). Both legs returned ACCEPT stage complete, but the portable verdictSha256 was 5a51f58d... versus native 225e97f7..., so the gate refused CEM_VERDICT_VERIFIER_DISAGREEMENT verifier-disagreement. After rebuilding cem01-go from origin/main 575939667 both legs agree on 225e97f7.... Expected: the gate (or corvint-update / the install recipe) detects a portable consumer built from a different source revision than the native verifier and refuses with a named stale-consumer code and the rebuild command. Actual: an opaque disagreement that reads like a verifier defect.
title: cem-verdict gate refuses verifier-disagreement when ~/.local/bin/cem01-go is older than the installed corvint; nothing checks the two builds match
